title: database.grant_revoked
description: A grant ended before or at its end time: revoked by a person, given back by the agent, or expired (written by the sweeper). `node_id` of the entry is the database. Names, IDs and counts only: never a row value, a parameter or an engine message (decision 0004-8). This schema is the `data` of a journal entry with `type` `database.grant_revoked`. Step 2, planned (decision 0004-21).
